transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I’m here because... I guess I’ve gotten to the point where I plan my whole summer around avoiding wasps. It's just getting in the way of everything. I even had to give up my garden jobs at the church, and... well, if I hear so much as a buzzing sound near the back porch, I make my husband go out and unload things for me. I just can't be out there.
Aside from wasps, do you have strong fears of any other specific situations or places?
No, not really. It's pretty much just the wasps. I don't have any trouble with, you know, heights or flying or anything else like that. It's really just those.
